title: SAAX Discovery A2A Extension Parameters
description: Versioned extension parameters for the SAAX Discovery A2A Agent Card extension (https://saax-protocol.com/extensions/saax-discovery/v1). A2A v1.0.0 AgentExtension.uri mechanism.

profileUrl.description: URL of the standalone profile. Application-level validation: https only, no fragment, origin matches the served origin.

standalonePath.description: Provisional fallback convention; NOT an IANA-registered standard.

prepareCommitment.description: https URL of the preflight endpoint, when implemented. Application-level validation: https, same-origin or explicitly authorized cross-origin.
